chemistry-killer-09.title: Mol
chemistry-killer-09.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-09.material: Doimiy harorat va bosimda A va B gazlari reaksiyaga kirishib C gazi hosil bo‘ladigan $\mathrm{aA(g) + bB(g) \rightarrow cC(g)}$ reaksiyasida A 20 mL va B 60 mL ortiqchasiz reaksiyaga kirishib C 40 mL hosil qiladi. A ning molekulyar massasi 28, B ning molekulyar massasi 2 va A hamda B ning 100 mL aralashmasi (o‘rtacha molekulyar massa 12,4) shu harorat va bosimda to‘liq reaksiyaga kirishtirildi. Reaksiyadan keyingi gaz aralashmasining zichligi reaksiyadan oldingining necha baravari?
chemistry-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: Doimiy harorat va bosimda A va B gazlari reaksiyaga kirishib C gazi hosil bo‘ladigan $\mathrm{aA(g) + bB(g) \rightarrow cC(g)}$ reaksiyasida A 20 mL va B 60 mL ortiqchasiz reaksiyaga kirishib C 40 mL hosil qiladi. A ning molekulyar massasi 28, B ning molekulyar massasi 2 va A hamda B ning 100 mL aralashmasi (o‘rtacha molekulyar massa 12,4) shu harorat va bosimda to‘liq reaksiyaga kirishtirildi. Reaksiyadan keyingi gaz aralashmasining zichligi reaksiyadan oldingining necha baravari?
chemistry-killer-09.s.s1.explain:
1-bosqich: hajm nisbati A:B:C = 20:60:40 = 1:3:2, ya’ni $\mathrm{A + 3B \rightarrow 2C}$.
2-bosqich: 100 mL aralashma gazda A hajmi x: (28x + 2(100 − x))/100 = 12,4 → 26x + 200 = 1240 → x = 40 mL. Demak A 40 mL, B 60 mL.
3-bosqich: B 60 mL to‘liq reaksiyaga kirishsa A 20 mL sarflanadi va C 40 mL hosil bo‘ladi. Reaksiyadan keyin A 20 mL + C 40 mL = 60 mL.
4-bosqich: massa saqlanadi (molekulyar massa bilan tekshirish: reaksiyadan oldin 40×28 + 60×2 = 1240, keyin C ning molekulyar massasi (28+3×2)/2 = 17, 20×28 + 40×17 = 1240). Bir xil harorat va bosimda zichlik = massa/hajm bo‘lgani uchun keyin/oldin = 100/60 = 5/3.
Javob: 5/3 (a). (Noto‘g‘ri javoblar: 3/5 nisbatni teskari qilgan qiymat, 1 faqat massaning saqlanishiga qarab hajm o‘zgarishini e’tiborsiz qoldirgan qiymat, 5/4 A 40 mL qoladi deb noto‘g‘ri ko‘rib jami 80 mL deb hisoblagan qiymat)
chemistry-killer-09.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-09.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
